fusions.name: Puffball Burst
fusions.desc: Bursts a cloud of spores around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Mulching Butt
fusions.desc: Butts the target for 8 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It has a 60% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Lichen Ledge
fusions.desc: Grows a patch of moss 3 tiles across for 10 seconds. It restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Moss Cloak
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.
